reason: The submitted CIF parses and symmetry-expands as primitive cubic Pm-3n (No. 223), a=6.46465 A, V=270.1687 A^3, with fully occupied Ho 2a, Pt 6c, and S 8e sites giving Ho2Pt6S8 (16 atoms, Z=2; reduced HoPt3S4). All 18 detected reflections from 5-90 degrees index to this cell with no important unexplained line (strong/moderate position RMS about 0.00077 degrees). More decisively, the trace compares integrated intensities from the instantiated atomic model using Cu Kalpha anomalous scattering and nonnegative displacement factors: all 18 observed intensities fit with normalized residual about 0.0075. Independent P-43n refinements from seven sulfur-coordinate starts converge to x(S)=0.25000, enhancing to Pm-3n; wrong Pt 6b and P-43m realizations fail badly and predict strong absent reflections. The nominal 6c/6d variants are the same structure under a cubic basis rotation. Periodic geometry has no overlaps (minimum 2.2856 A), with coherent complete shells (Ho-S 8x2.7993 A and Pt-S 4x2.2856 A) and a charge-balanced mixed/average Pt-valence assignment is possible. No concrete diffraction-compatible incompatible realization survives, so another attempt is unlikely to add a materially different viable candidate.
